title: Merkle Lens
tagline: Trade off proof size, verification time, and update cost across Merkle-style commitment schemes.

curves.label: Binary Merkle Tree
curves.code: const log=n=>Math.log(n)/Math.log(2); let cost=8+18*log(n)+0.02*n; return cost;
curves.name: Binary Merkle Tree

curves.label: Sparse Merkle Tree
curves.code: const log=n=>Math.log(n)/Math.log(2); let t=Math.max(1,log(n)); let cost=20+22*log(n)+0.04*Math.sqrt(n)+0.12*n/t; return cost;
curves.name: Sparse Merkle Tree

curves.label: Vector Commit (Kate-style)
curves.code: const log=n=>Math.log(n)/Math.log(2); let nn=n*n/Math.max(1,n); let cost=12+26*log(n)+0.0009*nn; return cost;
curves.name: Vector Commit (Kate-style)

curves.label: Folded Merkle Accumulator
curves.code: const log=n=>Math.log(n)/Math.log(2); let t=log(n); let cost=6+10*t+0.03*n+12/(1+t); return cost;
curves.name: Folded Merkle Accumulator
